description: CDEMO-USER-TYPE is inbound only, and this case proves it with a byte that is neither of the two condition values. app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:150 - MOVE SEC-USR-TYPE TO CDEMO-USER-TYPE - is COMMENTED OUT in the source, and it is the program's only mention of any SEC-USER-DATA field, so nothing here derives, defaults or looks up the user type: the byte the client supplied must come back unaltered even when it satisfies neither 88 CDEMO-USRTYP-ADMIN nor 88 CDEMO-USRTYP-USER. A type of 'X' therefore travels the full dispatch path to option 2 and arrives at COACTUPC exactly as it left the client, while the filter's first conjunct at line 136 is false because 'X' is not 'U'. Implementing the commented line would additionally require reading USRSEC, which this program never opens.
